capabilities: support running Mythic Game Master Emulator sessions in the vault
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation lives in a GitHub wiki ("How-to-write-your-own-adventure") rather than the README. Based on Mythic Game Master Emulator Second Edition (2025) by Tana Pigeon under CC BY-NC 4.0 and is not an official Word Mill Games product. Questions go to GitHub Discussions; defects and enhancements to the Issues tab.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tooling for running the Mythic Game Master Emulator during tabletop roleplaying sessions.

relations.evidence: This plugin is used to support the Mythic Game Master Emulator on Obsidian.
relations.plugin: Mythic Game Master Emulator (Word Mill Games)

summary: Solo-RPG helper that supports playing sessions of the Mythic Game Master Emulator inside Obsidian.
